long_biography.plain_text:
Steven Lowy spent more than three decades helping turn Westfield from an Australian shopping-centre company into an international property group. Joining in 1987 after investment-banking work, he started as a centre manager in New Jersey and eventually became co-chief executive, responsible for acquisitions, disposals, development and market strategy. The 2014 restructuring concentrated Westfield Corporation on major centres in Britain and the United States.

Lowy has paired business leadership with sustained institutional service. He is deputy chairman of the Lowy Institute and a director of both the Lowy Foundation and Lowy Medical Research Institute. Earlier chairmanships included Football Federation Australia, the Art Gallery of New South Wales trustees and the Victor Chang Cardiac Research Institute, spanning sport, culture, medicine and public policy.

uncertainties.detail: The owner record spells the given name Stephen and marks gender as Female. Authoritative Australian sources identify Steven Mark Lowy, male, while a separate British hospitality executive is genuinely named Stephen Lowy. The dossier retains the immutable source display name in the owner snapshot but proposes corrections to the editable identity and sort fields.

Frank Lowy founded Westfield before Steven joined it. Steven subsequently acquired personal securities interests, received performance-right equity and made a material operating contribution, while family trusts and associates held the much larger family interest. Because Frank remains living and the evidence does not establish inheritance of the principal stake, the dossier uses Marriage / family transfer rather than Inherited, while explicitly preserving Steven's expansion work.

The 2018 transaction ended Westfield Corporation as the family's operating platform. Current evidence identifies Steven as a principal of LFG, which invests across listed equities, real estate and technology. The dossier therefore classifies current primary industry as Finance & Investments and does not treat former Westfield, Scentre Group or every LFG portfolio asset as personally owned by Steven.

Official current biographies establish Sydney and 1962. Wikipedia reports 24 November 1962, but no equally strong primary source located confirms the day and month, so only place of birth and birth year are proposed.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was verified. Search results surfaced multiple Steven and Stephen Lowy namesakes. The exact, cross-corroborated Wikipedia page is proposed; Frank Lowy's Forbes page and the LFG company profile are retained as evidence rather than mislabelled as Steven's personal profiles.

Current net worth, rankings, transaction values, private family detail, politics, religion, allegations, tax controversy and all vessel facts are excluded from the biographies. Public and private asset distinctions remain in classification metadata rather than published prose.
